entries.task: Find planted bugs: 105 across two repositories, count fixed
entries.metric: planted bugs fixed, mean of 3, out of 105
entries.timeDefinition: wall clock of runs that shared the machine
entries.costDefinition: list-rate API price, not subscription billing
entries.limitations: Counts planted bugs, not review quality on real changes; repeated attempts are not independent replications; recorded from the maintainer's benchmark notes and not fetched again when this entry was written
entries.rationale: Medium used about 30% less cost and 29% less time than high for 1.4 fewer bugs; xhigh found more bugs at much higher cost and time. Medium supports a balanced starting point, not equivalence
